description: This PHP file defines a class 'Roman' which provides functions to convert numbers into Roman numerals, with support for different styles and array arguments. It is part of the PhpSpreadsheet calculation library for Excel functions, specifically in the MathTrig calculation namespace.

classes.name: Roman
classes.description: Provides methods to convert integers to Roman numerals, supporting different styles and array input for batch processing.

methods.name: evaluate
methods.description: Main method to convert a number (or array of numbers) into a Roman numeral string with specified style, handling array inputs and errors.
